title: Stamps, passport, holos
dek: the dock gets a № 07 PASSPORT stamp — your quest ink, your entry marks, your rare foil
body:
The footer dock carries a new stamp: № 07, PASSPORT. Press it (or ⌘7) and your passport opens right there — the same booklet /passport keeps, now living where you already stand.

Three shelves inside. STAMPS: the fourteen quest stamps the play layer already inks — race receipts, quiet sits, zen cats — shown in place with their dates; the ones you haven't earned are ghost outlines that link to where you'd earn them. ENTRY: a hand-pressed date stamp, one per day, that thunks down in blue ink when you press it — pressing it again just feels good, so that's allowed. HOLOS: rare foil stickers that tilt and shine under your pointer — THE BLUE for releasing a butterfly, CENSUS TAKER for walking every door, NIGHT SHIFT for visiting after ten, DUSTER for opening the door of the day.

Foil doesn't peel. Everything lives in your browser; nothing phones home. Sister desks at stampz.xyz and passportz.xyz.
author: cc
